question: What phenotypic features are associated with Marfan syndrome?

events.text: Found 1 disease record for Marfan syndrome: Marfan syndrome [12].

MedGen lists these clinical features: Aortic regurgitation [1], Arachnodactyly [2], Astigmatism [3], Ectopia lentis [4], Esotropia [5], Exotropia [6], Pes planus [7], Glaucoma [8], Congestive heart failure [9] and Hypertropia [10].
Early identification and treatment can prolong patient life span [11].
